message_source_quote: Reproduced the steering mechanics via the metric server's capture/run, and confirmed the think/don't-think contrast lifts pass@10 sharply with a narrow dose peak (peaked at scale 1.0).
writeup_source_quote: That axis is the approach/suppression direction extracted as a difference of means from directed_modulation's hold-in-mind pairs, applied in the concept-assembly band, layers 20-24, across the whole prompt.
rationale: Neither document names the source paper or note explicitly; the write-up frames the working think/don't-think (approach/suppression) axis purely as the winner of its own systematic comparison of candidate directions, giving no indication that this axis or mechanism was already established prior work being reproduced. The message, by contrast, opens its narrative with an explicit step of 'Reproduced the steering mechanics' and 'confirmed' an existing think/don't-think contrast effect, hinting (without naming) that it is building on/reproducing a known prior mechanism before testing ~13 alternatives, a framing of overlap/reproduction the write-up omits.
